general.description: This demo runs docTR, an OCR pipeline for document text detection and recognition. It exposes detector, recognizer, preprocessing, orientation, grouping, and post-processing parameters, and returns JSON, hOCR, text, CSV, final overlays, and intermediate diagnostic visualizations.

params.label: Text detector
params.comments: Selects the neural network used to localize text regions before recognition. FAST models are good CPU defaults; DBNet and LinkNet are useful for comparison. Code: ocr_predictor(det_arch=args.det_arch, ...).

params.label: Detector input size
params.comments: Size, in pixels, of the square tensor sent to the text detector. Default 1024 matches docTR 1.0.1 for the exposed detectors. Recommended values to try: 512, 768, 1024, 1280, 1536. Smaller values are faster but may miss small text; larger values cost more CPU and memory. Code: predictor.det_predictor.pre_processor.resize.size = (value, value).

params.label: Preserve detector aspect ratio
params.comments: Resize the page to fit inside the detector square without distorting it. If enabled and the page is not square, docTR adds padding; if disabled, the page is stretched. Maps to ocr_predictor(preserve_aspect_ratio=...). Code: ocr_predictor(preserve_aspect_ratio=args.preserve_aspect_ratio, ...).

params.label: Detector symmetric padding
params.comments: Only applies when detector aspect ratio is preserved. If enabled, padding is split on both sides; if disabled, padding is added at the bottom/right. Maps to ocr_predictor(symmetric_pad=...). Code: ocr_predictor(symmetric_pad=args.symmetric_pad, ...).

params.label: Assume straight pages
params.comments: Use for normal scans/photos with horizontal text. Disable for rotated or skewed text regions; this may return polygon boxes and is slower. Code: ocr_predictor(assume_straight_pages=args.assume_straight_pages, ...).

params.label: Straighten pages
params.comments: Try to rotate the page into a straighter orientation before OCR. Can help uniformly rotated pages, but is slower. Code: ocr_predictor(straighten_pages=args.straighten_pages, ...).

params.label: Detect orientation
params.comments: Estimate and report page orientation in JSON. Mostly diagnostic unless combined with straightening. Code: ocr_predictor(detect_orientation=args.detect_orientation, ...).

params.label: Disable page orientation model
params.comments: Advanced diagnostic switch. It maps to ocr_predictor(disable_page_orientation=...). If enabled, docTR's page orientation predictor is replaced by a disabled predictor returning zero rotation. Code: ocr_predictor(disable_page_orientation=args.disable_page_orientation, ...).

params.label: Text recognizer
params.comments: Selects the neural network used to read each detected word crop. CRNN models are faster; PARSeq and ViTSTR are heavier alternatives. Code: ocr_predictor(reco_arch=args.reco_arch, ...).

params.label: Recognizer padding / preserve aspect ratio
params.comments: docTR recognizer crops are resized to the recognizer tensor while preserving aspect ratio by default. This modifies predictor.reco_predictor.pre_processor.resize.preserve_aspect_ratio. Code: predictor.reco_predictor.pre_processor.resize.preserve_aspect_ratio = args.reco_preserve_aspect_ratio.

params.label: Recognizer symmetric padding
params.comments: When recognizer padding is enabled, pad word crops symmetrically instead of only at the bottom/right. This modifies predictor.reco_predictor.pre_processor.resize.symmetric_pad. Code: predictor.reco_predictor.pre_processor.resize.symmetric_pad = args.reco_symmetric_pad.

params.label: Disable crop orientation model
params.comments: Advanced diagnostic switch. It maps to ocr_predictor(disable_crop_orientation=...). It only matters when assume_straight_pages is disabled and crop rectification would otherwise use the crop orientation model. Code: ocr_predictor(disable_crop_orientation=args.disable_crop_orientation, ...).

params.label: Binarization threshold
params.comments: Threshold applied to the detector probability map before extracting candidate text components. Default 0.1 matches docTR's no-argument FAST-base run; DBNet detectors internally default to 0.3. Code: predictor.det_predictor.model.postprocessor.bin_thresh = args.bin_thresh.

params.label: Box threshold
params.comments: Minimum score required to keep a detected text box after detector post-processing. Code: predictor.det_predictor.model.postprocessor.box_thresh = args.box_thresh.

params.label: Box expansion ratio
params.comments: Expansion ratio used by the detector post-processor when converting text components into boxes. Default 1.0 matches docTR's no-argument FAST-base run; DBNet and LinkNet internally default to 1.5. Code: predictor.det_predictor.model.postprocessor.unclip_ratio = args.unclip_ratio when available.

params.label: Export straight boxes
params.comments: Convert rotated/polygon boxes into rectangular boxes in JSON and hOCR. Easier downstream, but loses exact rotated geometry. Code: ocr_predictor(export_as_straight_boxes=args.export_as_straight_boxes, ...).

params.label: Resolve lines
params.comments: Group detected words into text lines after recognition. Code: ocr_predictor(resolve_lines=args.resolve_lines, ...), forwarded to DocumentBuilder.

params.label: Resolve blocks
params.comments: Group resolved lines into larger text blocks or paragraph-like regions. Code: ocr_predictor(resolve_blocks=args.resolve_blocks, ...), forwarded to DocumentBuilder.

params.label: Paragraph break
params.comments: Relative gap threshold used while grouping words and lines. Smaller values split more aggressively; larger values merge across wider spaces. Code: ocr_predictor(paragraph_break=args.paragraph_break, ...), forwarded to DocumentBuilder.

params.label: Detect language
params.comments: Infer language from recognized text and store it in JSON. Does not change OCR predictions. Code: ocr_predictor(detect_language=args.detect_language, ...).

params.label: Draw word labels
params.comments: Write recognized word strings next to word boxes in overlay images. Code: visualization only, used by save_overlay(..., draw_labels=args.draw_labels, ...).

params.label: Draw confidence
params.comments: Append recognition confidence values to word labels in overlay images. Code: visualization only, used by save_overlay(..., draw_confidence=args.draw_confidence, ...).

params.label: Minimum display confidence
params.comments: Minimum recognition confidence for drawing a word in diagnostic overlays. Does not filter JSON, CSV, hOCR, or text outputs. Code: visualization only, used by save_overlay(..., min_confidence=args.min_confidence_display).

params.label: Recognizer crop samples
params.comments: Number of word crops sampled for recognizer stack/contact-sheet visualizations. Does not change OCR results. Code: visualization only, used by sample_indices(len(crops), args.recognizer_sample_count, ...).

params.label: Visualization seed
params.comments: Random seed used only to choose which detected word crops appear in recognizer diagnostic images. Code: visualization only, used by random.Random(args.visualization_seed) for crop sampling.
